action: Before rotating representation families, test the earliest lossy operator against exact target-regime structure with a preregistered DifferenceWitness; preserve the old failure as scoped to that operator.
boundaries: does not assert every failed majorant can be sharpened
does not transfer source mathematics from Poincare
does not create RH or literature novelty authority
same-context episode evidence is not independent assurance
expected_effects: avoid false saturation caused by an overlossy bound
reopen a valid local path without erasing negative history
falsifier: In a prospectively frozen target where a representation rotation is proposed, show that every admissible target-native sharpening of the earliest lossy operator still fails the same discriminator, or that the operator was already sharp enough in the target regime.
trigger_signature: a route is about to abandon an exact representation after failure of a non-sharp intermediate majorant
the target regime has additional exact structure not used by the majorant
validation_obligations: prospective matched replay against at least one case where representation rotation is genuinely necessary
measure false-retention and false-rotation rates under matched resources
do not promote without independent assurance and existing v3 gates
